speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. You presented with right groin pain and abnormal leg positioning after a rear-end collision; can you tell me exactly how your leg was positioned when you were first found?

speaker: Patient
text: 25-year-old female. The patient was involved in a rear-end collision where she was the restrained driver of the back car. She reports immediate onset of pain in both knees and severe pain over the right groin area following the accident.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Anterior Dislocation of the Right Femoral Head.

The mechanism of injury (rear-end collision) combined with immediate severe groin pain and the patient's age (25) strongly suggests a hip dislocation. Please confirm if the right leg appears externally rotated, shortened, and held in flexion.
